notes.title: Patch v1.02 & Trading Cards Up!
notes.content:
Patch v1.01: Fixed the bug afflicting the character screen menu.

Patch v1.02: Fixed the bug that occurs in Episode 4 during "Seeds of Disaster" where the screen becomes black and freezes with an error message.

Both patches are included in the latest update.

Trading cards are now fully available!

notes.title: Trading cards are coming!
notes.content:
We're planning on adding trading cards to this title shortly! Once everything is finalized we'll open them up right away, should only be a day or so!

So don't let that stop ya; make sure you pick up Dead End Junction during the 15% launch release!

notes.title: Yee-haw! Let's get this show on the road!
notes.content:
Now this is a title we've really been looking forward to releasing. A lot of research about the Wild West genre went into this title, and the history of the United States was well known to the localization team.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/518280

We really hope that people find something special in Dead End Junction - and we're celebrating with a 15% launch discount!
